description: This file defines a generic interface for lookup data responses in a Blazor Shared project, providing a List property to hold lookup data items.

classes.name: ILookupDataResponse
classes.description: A generic interface for encapsulating a list of lookup data objects, where TLookupData extends LookupData.

methods.name: List
methods.description: A get/set property that holds a list of lookup data items.
